  | [ $out[] | {k:(keys_unsorted|join(",")),
      t:([(.user_id|type),(.username|type),(.email|type),(.last_login|type),(.role_count|type),(.primary_role|type)]|join(",")),
      d:(.last_login|test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")),
      rc:(.role_count == $rc[(.user_id|tostring)])} ] as $rows
  | "key order variants: " + ([$rows[].k]|unique|join(" || ")),
    "type variants: " + ([$rows[].t]|unique|join(" || ")),
